claims.claim: The game features destructible environments and maps that require deep knowledge and strategy.

citations.review_text: Rainbow Six Siege (R6) is an amazing game because it takes skill, teamwork, and strategy to win. Unlike other shooting games, you can't just run around and shoot everything. You have to think about what you're doing, communicate with your teammates, and make smart decisions. There are tons of different operators to choose from, each with their own special abilities and gadgets, which makes every match feel different. The maps also make the game exciting because you can use different strategies and find new ways to outsmart the other team. What makes R6 so fun is that every round is different, and even when you're losing, you can still make a comeback. Overall, Rainbow Six Siege is an amazing game because it takes real skill, keeps you entertained, and never gets boring.

single_points.text: One reviewer says that everything loved about the game is gone, the recruit has been butchered, the art style vanished, and team play is dead.

citation.review_text:
I bought this game on Xbox when it released. Solid game. Had a great time playing it. An amazing game when it released.

Started playing it again a decade later. And everything I loved about the game is gone. Nothing of it remains. Recruit has been butchered. Team play is dead. The art style vanished. Everything has been rewired into oblivion. The guns are awful. The gadgets are worse. I can guarantee you that you picked the wrong operator 99% of the time. 

The game's sense of rock, paper, bang is so far gone that I don't understand what they're even trying to build on. None of these operators mesh.

Then, much to my detriment, the game goes free to play after I buy it. So, every cheater imaginable is clawing out of the walls. And I don't even get bonuses for having purchased the game. So, I feel more than ripped off from this.

claims.claim: Reviewers report widespread cheating, including aimbots and wallhacks, particularly in late-night matches.

citations.review_text: After 3000 hours im done. It sounds counter intuitive I know but this game just shit now. Ive been around since 2017 on ps4 and pc and vie never been this disappointed. If you somehow still play this game DONT download the "treacker.gg" app, it will ruin you. I figured before I was just getting bad but nope its these servers. Ill hit a head and watch the wall get painted just for the same guy to rinse me. look at tracker.gg ang guess what NONE OF MY HITS WERE REGISTERING YEYYYYYYYYY I LOVE THIS GAME. Don't even get me started on the non existent match making. as a silver you can expect to play with Gold Dimond and Emerald. The hacking problem is bad as ever. Normally id never advise cheating but at this point they should just give everyone wall hacks seeing how everyone has it anyway.  Last tip never watch a replay you will regularly see people staring at you through walls. I wont recommend a new game to you but I wouldn't recommend this one either it just doesn't work anymore. Good job Ubisoft you ruined your last good game enjoy bankruptcy

I genuinely want to love this game, i do. Its high moments are comparable to tarkov, its low moments are filled with 'i couldve done this better' and its absurd. One of the most complex team based shooters on the market, but it was one glaring issue,

You cannot play this game after 10:30 cst, dont even try. 10:30 CST has more cheaters than a rust 3x server, more cheaters than a casual csgo lobby, as many cheaters as 2019 tf2, and more cheaters than a tarkov customs or shoreline match. Its obcene, hard to even compare mid week day siege to late night siege. 

You may think 'well just go to unranked?' 
- I'd love to, truly, but when im a PLAT ONE and every single unranked match SOME HOW has multiple champs? what do you want me to do? I do my best to learn, I see their strats and do my best to replicate them, but i'm just trying to drink with the friends and enjoy the game, not be pixel peeked by 2-3 tcsg's every single match from lvl 28 account OR god forbid, the DOZENS of top 100 players ive fought in unranked. 

Okay, then go QP, QP takes the stress away right?
- Absolutely not, QP is filled to the brim with lvl 1-15 accounts that are cheating so hard youd think they were rushing an insta ban. Its actually unplayable, we were trying to level a friend up whos new to the game, nearly every match is full blatant walling and aimbotting. 

'then play ranked? Surely you'll be matched against account of similar skill' 
-Absolutely not. Play before 10:30 pm CST, YOURE PRAYING the guy whos gonna go 13/0/0 is on your team, if not, hes probably on the other team. God forbid you play after 10:30 pm. You will fight the most blatant walling, ai aimbotting, full on aimbotting players youve ever seen. Its unreal. 

Like i said, i want to love this game, but as with EVERY high skill game, losers will pollute it with cheats and boosting accounts. I quite literally couldn't count how many flat out cheaters with 0 recoil, aiming at me through walls, aiming at my head .5 seconds before…
the amount of times i seen a smurfer and cheaters in this game probably out numbers the  total bullets i shot in this game

claims.claim: Reviewers state that account support requests and appeals regarding hacked or banned accounts are routinely rejected or mishandled by customer service.

citations.review_text:
I have played Rainbow Six Siege since July 2016, with over 4,400 hours on this Steam account, and I have spent a lot of money on this game over the years, including R6 Credits just one month before what happened.

On September 26, 2026, my Ubisoft account was hacked. The hacker changed the email, password and username, and is still playing on my account today.

I opened six recovery cases with Ubisoft Support and provided everything I could:

Ubisoft Account Verification emails sent to my original email in 2024
Past support cases under my original username
My Rainbow Six Siege profile folder and in-game screenshots from 2020 showing my account logged in on my PC
Twitch Drops received on this account, and stream clips of me playing on it with my webcam on
Steam purchase receipts and my linked Steam ID

Every case was rejected because I “could not pass verification.” The problem is that Ubisoft sends the verification link to the email currently on the account, which now belongs to the hacker. The real owner can never pass that check.

Other platforms affected by the same attack returned my accounts after I proved ownership. Ubisoft is the only one that has not.

Back in March of 2026 I received a notification that my profile was signed into in the Philippines. I live in NYC. I immediately changed my security and went about my day going to work. I hadnt played Siege in months. 2 days later when i did try to play i found out i had been perma banned for cheating, of which I have never done and my k/d can prove it. After months of going back n forth with support, being left in the dark about my case, and having it closed only for me to reopen it, I've finally gone through the appeal process and was denied appeal. 7 MONTHS LATER. It is absolutely insane that the game that i have almost 1000 hours in, paid for skins, and countless good times with my friends has been taken away from me. I will never purchase anything from them again. This company does not have your back. They are money hungry and disgusting
